collectionMethod: Public web search for aggregated complaint/opportunity THEMES and official procurement rules. No specific business named. No page copied verbatim — only short thematic summaries. All signals below are treated as UNVERIFIED public patterns, never ground truth.

sources.publicSignalSummary: Common dry-cleaning complaint themes: delayed/late-ready orders with no update, garment damage / stains not treated, lost or switched items (poor garment tracking), surprise fees, poor service recovery.
sources.privacyActionTaken: no business/customer names retained; themes only
sources.copyrightActionTaken: summarized themes; no verbatim review text
sources.notes: Consumer-advice aggregation of typical complaints, not a specific business.

sources.sourceRef: GFR 2017 EMD rules / GeM e-procurement EMD + exemption guidance (public explainers)
sources.publicSignalSummary: Government tenders typically require an Earnest Money Deposit (1-5% of contract value), tender fee, eligibility documents; MSME/startup exemptions exist with the right registration. Deadlines and eligibility are hard gates.
missingData: cost/margin fit for the specific tender
sources.notes: Official procurement-rule pattern (STRONG) — but bid/no-bid still needs the owner's own eligibility + cost data.

sources.publicSignalSummary: Top tenant complaint themes: slow response to urgent maintenance (AC, hot water), unreturned calls/emails, security-deposit disputes, surprise fees, unresolved pest issues. Reviews polarize 1-star/5-star.
sources.notes: Polarized public reviews are weak evidence of any one business's true state.

sources.publicSignalSummary: Commercial cleaning complaint themes: missed areas / inconsistent quality (restrooms, dusting), missed shifts / no-shows, poor communication, no quality reporting/accountability, hidden fees, high staff turnover → untrained workers.
sources.notes: Turnover→training is a recurring root cause; SOP/training route is appropriate but needs adherence evidence.

sources.sourceRef: franchise consistency / brand-standard guides (delightree, taqtics, trainual)
sources.publicSignalSummary: Franchise themes: service quality varies branch-to-branch, uneven SOP execution, visual-branding inconsistency, unauthorized local promos/discounts, outdated training; one branch's mistake harms the whole brand. SOPs usually updated only after a complaint/audit.
sources.notes: Brand/pricing/cash decisions must stay owner-gated; no franchisee penalty automation.

sources.sourceRef: SaaS negative-review theme guides (userpilot, madx, bigideasdb)
sources.publicSignalSummary: SaaS negative-review themes: bugs/downtime, poor/slow support, onboarding overload (users can't complete setup), non-transparent pricing / value doubts, feature bloat/complexity, missing key features.
sources.notes: No fabricated MRR/conversion; launch readiness stays frozen if support/product gaps remain.

sources.sourceRef: RFP evaluation-criteria / vendor-selection guides (responsive.io, ivalua, tipalti)
sources.publicSignalSummary: B2B RFP evaluation themes: scope/technical fit, delivery reliability + capacity + geographic coverage, quality/certifications, service responsiveness, clear ROI/TCO (lowest cost rarely wins). Buyers value proven volume over theoretical capacity.
sources.notes: Outreach draft only; owner approval + capacity/cost proof before any pursuit; no win-probability fabrication.

sources.sourceRef: composite of the above public themes (growth signal + unresolved quality + missing cost data + weak capacity + high owner workload)
sources.publicSignalSummary: A composite business facing an expansion opportunity while quality complaints are unresolved, cost/margin data is missing, capacity/staffing is weak, and owner workload is already high — used to test collective (business-wide) decision coherence.
sources.notes: Explicitly synthetic conflict case; must yield validate-first, fix-quality-first, do-not-scale-yet.

notFound.detail: Verified per-business internal financials, real defect rates, capacity, and true conversion/MRR are NOT publicly available for any specific business and were NOT fabricated. Every case therefore carries missing-internal-data conditions the fixtures preserve honestly.
